checks.evidence: graphite-950/#0a0b0d bg + graphite-100/#dde2e8 text: 15.11:1 (AA✓ AAA✓). graphite-900/#101216 bg + graphite-300/#8b95a3 text: 6.18:1 (AA✓). graphite-950 bg + signal/#e5484d text: 5.03:1 (AA✓). graphite-900 bg + graphite-400/#5a6472 text: 3.13:1 (AA large-text✓, normal✗ — used for secondary labels). graphite-950 bg + graphite-500/#3d4552 text: 2.04:1 (fails both — used only for decorative/subtle hints).

checks.evidence: H1: 57.6px (lg breakpoint), H2: 30px, H3: 18px, Body: 16px. Font: Archivo Variable (Latin) / IBM Plex Sans Arabic (Arabic, loaded via @fontsource). Letter-spacing -0.02em on headings. tnum (tabular-nums) on all numeric values. Arabic line-height: 1.75 (vs 1.5 Latin). text-wrap: balance on headings, pretty on paragraphs.

checks.name: 19. RTL/LTR direction: html dir/lang switches correctly
checks.evidence: Default locale is 'ar' (rtl). App.jsx useEffect sets document.documentElement.lang and dir from LOCALES. Switching to 'en' sets dir=ltr, lang=en. ltr-token class (direction:ltr; unicode-bidi:isolate; white-space:nowrap) applied to model numbers, part numbers, prices. Calculator inputs have dir=ltr explicitly. Arabic text uses IBM Plex Sans Arabic with proper line-height.

checks.name: 20. Calculator interaction: form fills, validates, shows results
checks.evidence: Filled 4 fields (5000, 3000, 500, 25000 EGP). Submitted successfully. Results: Upgrade total=8500.00 EGP, Replacement total=25000.00 EGP, Difference=16500.00 EGP. Verdict: 'الترقية أقل تكلفة.' Green tag 'أقل تكلفة' rendered. Bar chart visible with upgrade=signal red, replacement=graphite-500. No console errors during interaction.

checks.name: 21. Console errors: zero across all pages
checks.evidence: Checked homepage, catalog, upgrade, calculator, compare. Total console errors: 0. Hero3D lazy-load catches WebGL failures gracefully (return without rendering). Lenis lazy-load handles chunk failures. No unhandled promise rejections.

checks.name: 22. Unfinished pages / placeholders: none in code, demo data visible
checks.evidence: No TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX comments in rendered HTML. Placeholder text count: 4 (legitimate: demo SKU names 'Synthetic Demo SKU', currency labels 'جنيه مصري'). No 'coming soon' or 'under construction' text. All 5 routes render complete UI with proper empty/loading/error states.

checks.name: 23. Broken interactions: none found
checks.evidence: Nav links navigate correctly via History API router. Locale switcher toggles dir/lang and re-renders all text. Search input submits form. Filter buttons (RAM, brand, use-case) toggle aria-pressed and active state. Price slider updates maxPrice state. Compare tray appears when items selected, shows count/max. Calculator submits to /api/v1/upgrade-or-replace and renders results. All interactions verified via Playwright.

checks.name: 24. Visual inconsistencies: numeral mixing, demo data, footer logic
checks.evidence: (1) Catalog page mixes numeral systems: Latin digits (16, 32) in RAM filter buttons vs. Eastern Arabic numerals (١٦, ٣٢) in product cards via Intl.NumberFormat ar-EG. (2) Storage shows '٠١٢ GB' — leading zero artifact from formatCount(12, 'ar') producing '٠١٢' instead of '١٢'. (3) Footer concatenates limits[0] + ' ' + limits[2], skipping limits[1], producing grammatically incomplete Arabic sentence. (4) Demo SKU names ('Synthetic Demo SKU EX-C15-01') visible in production catalog.

checks.name: 25. Design token radius lock: App.css stale code
checks.evidence: index.css design spec states: 'ONE radius family. 8px for every surface, input and button. 4px for chips and badges only. Nothing is a pill.' Active components comply. However, src/App.css (stale Vite template) contains .counter class with border-radius: 5px, violating the radius lock. This file is imported by App.jsx but the .counter class is not used anywhere in the app — dead code.

checks.name: 26. Compare page table: empty state works, full flow not E2E-tested
checks.evidence: Compare page shows empty state correctly when no items selected (dashed box with CTA). Table structure exists in DOM with caption for screen readers. However, the full compare flow (add 2+ items from catalog → tray appears → navigate to /compare → table renders with spec rows) was not executed end-to-end in this audit. Only the empty state was verified.

checks.name: 27. Performance: three.module chunk large but lazy-loaded
checks.evidence: Build warning: three.module-TzJVjowl.js = 528KB (gzipped 131KB). Hero3D is dynamically imported via React.lazy() so it does not block initial paint. Lenis (19KB) also lazy-loaded. No quantitative LCP/FID/CLS/TTFB metrics collected — would require Lighthouse or WebPageTest for verification.

checks.name: 28. Accessibility: skip-link, ARIA, focus-visible all present
checks.evidence: Skip-to-content link: sr-only, focus:not-sr-only, positioned top-left on focus. aria-current='page' on active nav link. aria-pressed on filter toggle buttons. aria-invalid on calculator inputs with errors. aria-describedby links errors to inputs. aria-live='polite' on LoadingRows and calculator pending state. focus-visible: 2px solid signal with 2px offset. All interactive elements have ≥44px tap targets on mobile.

checks.name: 29. Responsive breakpoints: verified at 1440x900 and 390x844
checks.evidence: Desktop (1440x900): grid-cols-12 layout, sidebar sticky, full nav visible, 3-column card grid at xl. Mobile (390x844): single-column stack, collapsible filter sidebar (hidden by default, toggled via button), 2-column card grid at sm, full-width buttons. No horizontal overflow at either breakpoint. Touch targets ≥44px.

checks.name: 30. Arabic copy quality: awkward phrasing in i18n and site-copy
checks.evidence: i18n.js line 6: 'بحد أقصى منزلتين عشريتين و999999.99 جنيه لكل خانة' — awkward phrasing mixing numeric format with Arabic text. Should read more naturally. site-copy.js line 24: footer concatenates home.limits[0] + ' ' + home.limits[2], skipping limits[1], producing incomplete statement. Some button labels verbose ('شوف لو ينفع تطوره' vs shorter 'فحص الترقية').

frontend_checklist: Homepage hero: 3D laptop viewfinder, headline, CTAs, stats bar
Laptop finder (catalog): search, RAM/brand/price/use-case filters, product grid, pagination
Laptop detail (SkuDetail): specs table, upgrade potential panel, storage slots
Comparison page: empty state, table with 2-4 SKUs, remove buttons, attribute rows
Upgrade advisor: part number lookup, RAM slots, storage slots, verification tone chips
Cost calculator: 4-field form, validation, result bars, verdict, disclaimer
Navigation: 5 links, sticky header, backdrop blur, locale switcher (AR/EN)
Footer: brand, tagline, limits statement (3 items), 4 quick links
Compare tray: fixed bottom bar, item count (n/4), clear/open actions
RTL support: html dir/lang switch, Arabic font (IBM Plex Sans Arabic), ltr-token for model numbers/prices
Design tokens: graphite scale (11 levels), signal/positive state colors, radius lock (8px/4px)
Typography: Archivo Variable, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, tabular-nums, text-wrap balance, heading hierarchy
Accessibility: skip-link, aria attributes, focus-visible, aria-live regions, 44px touch targets
high_gaps: Numeral system inconsistency: Latin digits (16, 32 GB) in filter buttons mixed with Eastern Arabic numerals (١٦, ٣٢ GB) in product cards. Should normalize per locale.
Demo SKU names ('Synthetic Demo SKU EX-C15-01') visible in production. Seed with realistic data or hide behind feature flag.
Storage value '٠١٢ GB' shows leading-zero artifact from formatCount(12, 'ar-EG') — likely Intl.NumberFormat behavior with Arabic-Indic digits. Needs formatting fix.
Footer honesty line concatenates limits[0] + ' ' + limits[2] skipping limits[1], producing grammatically incomplete Arabic sentence. Should use all 3 limits or restructure.
Compare page full flow not E2E-tested: empty state verified but adding items → table render not executed end-to-end.
App.css contains stale .counter class with border-radius: 5px (violates 8px/4px radius lock). Dead code but signals template remnants.
